military.note: WWI draft registration, Alameda Co., Calif.

bioAdditions: George Julius Wagner, b. California 27 Jan 1876, son of Theodore F. C. Wagner and Ida Sandow; registered to vote in Alameda in 1897; died 1927 (California Death Index) (S1).
